1.why: The user interface maintains a static, clean layout without pop-up windows or visual movement.

2.why: Primary action buttons and section headings feature high contrast and distinct visual hierarchy.

3.why: Users must locate and copy tokens from technical console log boxes located at the bottom of the page.

4.why: The procedure requires multi-step token copying alongside complex password composition rules.

6.why: The interface presents generic form inputs rather than recognized personalized account details.

7.why: Instructional text contains technical phrasing such as non-identifying contact values and local mock deliveries.

8.why: The interface screens illustrate a standard success path without displaying explicit error resolution guidance.

9.why: Password requirements are listed textually, but input boxes lack sample placeholder formats.

10.why: The system mandates a single fixed linear flow without offering alternative authentication choices.

11.why: Screens present one focused card container and single primary action button per step.

12.why: Dedicated confirmation steps clearly state the successful outcome of completed actions.

13.why: Short descriptive instructions and security notes guide the user through each sequential step.

14.why: Standard text inputs can be re-edited, but explicit back or undo buttons are absent.

15.why: The header, card layout, color palette, and log structure remain consistent across all screens.
